initContainers.name: k6
args:
cd /tests
test ! -e /results/summary.json
test ! -e /results/points.jsonl
test ! -e /results/measurement-start.txt
test ! -e /results/measurement-end.txt
test ! -e /results/exit-code.txt
printf '%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > /results/measurement-start.txt
code=0
k6 run --no-usage-report --config workloads/smoke/checkout.json --summary-export /results/summary.json --out json=/results/points.jsonl tests/checkout/scenario.js > /results/runner.log 2>&1 || code=$?
printf '%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > /results/measurement-end.txt
printf '%s\n' "$code" > /results/exit-code.txt
test -s /results/summary.json
test -s /results/points.jsonl

containers.name: publish-raw
args:
umask 027
printf '[default]\ns3 =\n    addressing_style = path\n' > /tmp/awsconfig
aws_s3() {
  aws --endpoint-url "$PERFENG_S3_ENDPOINT" --cli-connect-timeout 10 --cli-read-timeout 60 s3api "$@"
}
publish() {
  file="$1"
  key="$2"
  media_type="$3"
  format="$4"
  reference="$5"
  set -- $(sha256sum "$file")
  sha256="$1"
  size="$(wc -c < "$file" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
  proposed_id="$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid)"
  if aws_s3 put-object --bucket perfeng-artifacts --key "$key" --body "$file" --if-none-match "*" --content-type "$media_type" --metadata "artifact-id=$proposed_id,sha256=$sha256,format=$format" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'Published %s\n' "$key"
  else
    printf 'Publication was not acknowledged; verifying %s\n' "$key"
  fi
  download="/tmp/$(basename "$key").download"
  rm -f "$download"
  aws_s3 get-object --bucket perfeng-artifacts --key "$key" "$download" >/dev/null
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$download" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
  test "$(wc -c < "$download" | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "$size"
  test "$(aws_s3 head-object --bucket perfeng-artifacts --key "$key" --query ContentLength --output text)" = "$size"
  test "$(aws_s3 head-object --bucket perfeng-artifacts --key "$key" --query ContentType --output text)" = "$media_type"
  stored_id="$(aws_s3 head-object --bucket perfeng-artifacts --key "$key" --query 'Metadata."artifact-id"' --output text)"
  printf '%s\n' "$stored_id" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  test "$(aws_s3 head-object --bucket perfeng-artifacts --key "$key" --query Metadata.sha256 --output text)" = "$sha256"
  test "$(aws_s3 head-object --bucket perfeng-artifacts --key "$key" --query Metadata.format --output text)" = "$format"
  if [ -n "$reference" ]; then
    printf '{"id":"%s","runId":"%s","kind":"raw","uri":"s3://perfeng-artifacts/%s","sha256":"%s","sizeBytes":%s,"mediaType":"%s","format":"%s"}' "$stored_id" "$PERFENG_RUN_ID" "$key" "$sha256" "$size" "$media_type" "$format" > "$reference"
  fi
}
case "$PERFENG_RUN_ID" in
  perf-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]) ;;
  *) printf 'Invalid Run identity\n' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
start="$(cat /results/measurement-start.txt)"
end="$(cat /results/measurement-end.txt)"
exit_code="$(cat /results/exit-code.txt)"
case "$exit_code" in ''|*[!0-9]*) printf 'Invalid k6 exit code\n' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
printf 'Publishing k6 evidence for Run %s (exit %s)\n' "$PERFENG_RUN_ID" "$exit_code"
publish /results/summary.json "runs/$PERFENG_RUN_ID/summary.json" application/json k6-summary-json /tmp/summary-reference.json
publish /results/points.jsonl "runs/$PERFENG_RUN_ID/points.jsonl" application/x-ndjson k6-json-points /tmp/points-reference.json
created="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
{
  printf '{"schemaVersion":2,"kind":"RawResult","contractsVersion":"0.13.0","runId":"%s","testId":"checkout-api",' "$PERFENG_RUN_ID"
  printf '"workload":{"id":"checkout-smoke","version":"1.0.0","sha256":"a051d5beba6b0631e9592cf28148aec32f4b396f79d2ed5268b318ec1191ce0c"},'
  printf '"producer":{"name":"k6","version":"2.2.0","artifact":{"kind":"oci-image","image":"ghcr.io/stanimirivanov/perfeng-k6@sha256:f40f15780dd4eb8124a327c5d7a051848276494bec77f2c18590520be5c5c962"}},'
  printf '"measurementWindow":{"start":"%s","end":"%s"},"createdAt":"%s","artifacts":[' "$start" "$end" "$created"
  cat /tmp/summary-reference.json
  printf ','
  cat /tmp/points-reference.json
  printf ']}\n'
} > /tmp/raw-result.json
publish /tmp/raw-result.json "runs/$PERFENG_RUN_ID/raw-result.json" application/json raw-result/v2 ''
printf 'Verified raw-result/v2 publication for Run %s\n' "$PERFENG_RUN_ID"
